sources.known_gaps: All dated entries currently published on the official release-notes index, including mobile, Studio and model announcements. Earlier changes absent from this endpoint are outside coverage.
All dated descriptions currently available on the official changelog. Multiple announcements on one date remain separate; the source does not provide individual entry permalinks.

Posts listed in the official updates sitemap, including alpha tests and community announcements. Dates are article publication dates, not sitemap modification dates or dates mentioned in titles; older Discord-only announcements are outside coverage.
All published entries returned by the official public changelog, traversing every cumulative page. Drafts, deleted entries and private feedback are excluded.

Dated announcement summaries on the official updates index, including launch and company announcements listed there. Full blog article text and unlisted maintenance changes are outside this source's scope.
Dated versions of the Antigravity App (hub) and original IDE on the official changelog. Separately versioned CLI, SDK, editor extensions and undated model-launch cards are outside this scope.

All updates exposed by the official public Updates page's notification feed. Entries use the feed's publication timestamp; entries without a public blog permalink link to the Updates index. Private account notifications are outside coverage.

Curated release summaries linked from the official documentation release index, dated using published_at of the matching stable GitHub tag. Calendar-looking version numbers are not dates. Older technical changelog records and prereleases outside this index are excluded.
Every version currently listed in the paginated official product changelog, including CLI and app changes. GitHub tags not listed in this curated endpoint are outside coverage.
